item.title: Seamless KMP on iOS: Enhancing the Experience with SKIE
item.author: ignacio@carrion.dev (Ignacio Carrión)
item.description: Seamless KMP on iOS: Enhancing the Experience with SKIE Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) is a game-changer for sharing business logic across platforms. However, for iOS developers consuming this shared code, the experience can sometimes feel foreign. This is because KMP compiles to iOS via Objective-C interoperability, which doesn’t natively support some of modern Kotlin’s (and Swift’s) best features. This is where SKIE (Swift Kotlin Interface Enhancer), developed and maintained by Touchlab, comes in.
item.dc:creator: Ignacio Carrión
